roles.functionStatement: Manage forest stands and landscapes toward stated objectives through measured, prescribed and administered treatments.

bands.indicativeBand: GS-5 to GS-7 (entry); GS-9 to GS-11 (journey)

majorDuties.duty: Prescribe and implement silvicultural treatments for stand objectives

tasks.statement: Write a silvicultural prescription for a stand from inventory data, site conditions and stated management objectives
Mark trees for a thinning or regeneration harvest to the prescription's residual density, species and structure targets
Audit a marked stand against its prescription by sampling residual basal area, spacing and leave-tree selection

majorDuties.duty: Inventory forest resources to stated precision with field plots and remote sensing

tasks.statement: Measure tree diameter, height, defect and age on inventory plots following the cruise or inventory protocol
Estimate stand attributes by combining field plots with airborne lidar, deciding where additional plots are needed to meet precision targets
Check-cruise a crew's inventory plots by blind re-measurement, recording differences outside the protocol tolerance

majorDuties.duty: Assess forest health and diagnose biotic and abiotic stressors

tasks.statement: Survey stands for insect, disease and abiotic damage, recording agent, severity and extent on survey plots
Diagnose the cause of tree decline from field symptoms, signs and site history, sending samples for laboratory confirmation

majorDuties.duty: Plan forest management and timber harvests to meet ecological and economic objectives

tasks.statement: Prepare a forest management plan that schedules harvests and treatments to meet ecological, economic and regeneration objectives
Lay out harvest unit boundaries, leave areas and skid trails on the ground to the plan's specifications and best management practices
Inspect active harvest operations for compliance with best management practices for water quality and soil protection

majorDuties.duty: Prepare and administer timber sale, stewardship and partner implementation agreements

tasks.statement: Translate a silvicultural or restoration prescription into a sale layout and contract specifications that a purchaser can bid on
Appraise timber value for a sale or stewardship contract from cruise volume, product mix, logging costs and market data
Inspect contract operations against specifications, enforcing contract remedies when the purchaser does not comply

majorDuties.duty: Project stand development under alternative treatments with calibrated growth models

tasks.statement: Project stand development under alternative treatments with a growth model, reporting each projection's assumptions and uncertainty
Classify a stand's development stage from field structure data to anticipate its response to treatment

majorDuties.duty: Identify organisms from field characters, specimens, images and recordings

tasks.statement: Identify regional plants and animals to species with dichotomous keys and diagnostic features, collecting evidence for any record not identified with certainty
Verify species records submitted by crews or volunteers against attached photos, recordings or vouchers before they enter the program database

majorDuties.duty: Ground-truth remote-sensed, modelled and AI-generated outputs in the field

tasks.statement: Decide where field calibration plots are still needed for a lidar or imagery-based inventory, targeting conditions where remote estimates fail
Record reference observations at pre-selected validation points with the reference protocol, without access to the product's predicted value

majorDuties.duty: Design fuels treatments that reduce wildfire hazard and verify their effects in the field

tasks.statement: Assess fuels in a planning area with standard fuel models and field sampling to set treatment priorities

majorDuties.duty: Conduct environmental impact review of proposed actions

tasks.statement: Prepare an environmental assessment of a proposed action, analyzing the reasonably foreseeable effects of the action and its alternatives within the procedure's page and time limits
Scope the review of a proposed action with cooperating agencies and the public, setting the purpose, alternatives and effects boundaries the analysis will cover

majorDuties.duty: Assess effects on protected species and conduct interagency consultation on proposed actions

tasks.statement: Compile species and habitat occurrence information for an action area, documenting the sources and survey dates used for each listed species

majorDuties.duty: Prepare and revise management plans for publicly held lands

tasks.statement: Coordinate an interdisciplinary team drafting a forest, range or refuge management plan, assigning plan components and reconciling conflicting resource objectives
Follow the agency's planning procedure and schedule for a plan revision or amendment, documenting each required step and its completion

majorDuties.duty: Assess tree risk and structural condition

tasks.statement: Verify remote-sensed or analytics-flagged tree risk scores on the ground, recording each override with the field reason

bands.pctTimeNotice: % time: set by the supervisor; EMST supplies none before job analysis.

roles.functionStatement: Reduce wildfire hazard and restore fire-adapted conditions through fuels treatments and prescribed fire executed within prescription and air-quality limits.

shown.label: Wildland fire position qualifications under the interagency standard (e.g., firefighter, burn boss, incident commander types)

instruments.label: USWFS-USFS aligned federal wildland fire qualification standards (IQCS 2026 Transition Plan)

majorDuties.duty: Conduct prescribed fire from burn planning through ignition, holding and evaluation

tasks.statement: Write a burn plan with objectives, prescription parameters, holding and contingency actions for a prescribed fire unit
Ignite a prescribed fire unit with hand-held devices following the firing pattern and the firing boss's direction
Monitor fire behaviour, weather and smoke during a burn against the prescription, reporting values outside it to the burn boss
Check holding resources, equipment and crew briefing completion against the burn plan before ignition begins
Evaluate fire effects on monitoring plots against burn objectives, recording outcomes that inform the next burn plan

majorDuties.duty: Operate and supervise uncrewed and automated field systems

tasks.statement: Operate an uncrewed aerial ignition system under the firing boss's direction, changing ignition lines as fire behaviour and holding capacity change

majorDuties.duty: Design fuels treatments that reduce wildfire hazard and verify their effects in the field

tasks.statement: Assess fuels in a planning area with standard fuel models and field sampling to set treatment priorities
Verify a remotely sensed fuels map in the field, correcting fuel-model assignments that misrepresent observed conditions
Supervise mechanical or hand fuels treatments to the prescription's residual fuel and canopy specifications
Evaluate fuels treatment effectiveness by re-measuring fuels and modelling fire behaviour after treatment

majorDuties.duty: Predict fire behaviour from fuels, weather and topography for operations and planning

tasks.statement: Predict fire spread, intensity and spotting for an operational period from fuels, weather and topography, stating assumptions

majorDuties.duty: Plan smoke management for prescribed and managed fire within air quality requirements

tasks.statement: Prepare the smoke management section of a burn plan, identifying sensitive receptors, dispersion limits and contingency actions
Compare a smoke dispersion forecast with monitor and observer data during a burn, recommending holding or stopping ignition when the forecast fails

majorDuties.duty: Sample and assess vegetation using standardized field protocols

tasks.statement: Establish vegetation monitoring plots to protocol and record species composition, cover and density within the program's measurement-quality objectives

majorDuties.duty: Read site history and reference conditions from landscape evidence

tasks.statement: Interpret fire scars, stumps, soil horizons and legacy structures at a site to reconstruct its disturbance and land-use history

majorDuties.duty: Plan and run field campaigns and remote logistics

tasks.statement: Schedule a field campaign against phenology, flow, tide or weather windows so that each protocol's sampling window is met
Secure access permissions for field sites from landowners and land managers before the season, recording the conditions of access for crews

majorDuties.duty: Manage risk in uncontrolled field environments

tasks.statement: Brief a field crew on the day's site hazards, escape routes, safety zones and communication plan before work begins

majorDuties.duty: Lead field crews and transfer field judgment to novices

tasks.statement: Lead a small crew through a field day, matching tasks to skill and checking novice work early and often

majorDuties.duty: Operate chainsaws and other power equipment safely in field conditions

tasks.statement: Fell trees with a chainsaw within the operator's certification limits, planning the face cut, hinge and escape route from the tree's size-up

majorDuties.duty: Ground-truth remote-sensed, modelled and AI-generated outputs in the field

tasks.statement: Code the likely field cause of each mismatch between a remote product and field observation, such as timing, mixed pixels, hidden understory or location error

majorDuties.duty: Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings

tasks.statement: Exercise stop-work authority when field, facility or incident conditions exceed the stated safety limits of the assignment
